it had gone into play permanently with a burn action attached.

Psychic Projection is seriously (IMO) the weak cousin of Psychic
Veil - you can use stealth for a turn 'on your own', but with
Projection you can only hope that the turn you play it will
actually be the turn you need intercept on.
